description:
##### Open to all players. Join now and be among the pioneers who help shape our guild from the very beginning. Every great guild starts with a few dedicated adventurers—be one of them.
#
###### Target Guild Hall Location : The Citadel
###
###### Est. 07/07/2026
#
##### Notes
###
Take a moment to read the information before submitting your application.
###
It is not mandatory but members are encouraged to donate to the Stockpile for guild maintenance and contribute to Challenges to earn guild marks. Members inactive for at least seven days may be removed to make room for active players unless prior notice is given. There are no rules for now unless we decide to become a competitive guild in the future.
#
##### New Player Tips (From Tavern)
###
You can play your main character however you like.
###
A useful tip is to create an additional Chef character dedicated to fishing and cooking. Sell the cooked food to vendors to earn gold, then transfer the gold to your main character. You can trade between your own characters once they reach Level 150.
###
You can also do the same with a Smelter character if you want another way to generate gold.
#
###### Goals : Build the Guild Foundation and construct a Teleportation Beacon at The Citadel to provide members with easy and affordable access to higher level resources and the World Bosses - Level 90 Voragor and Level 95 Thal'guth.
